query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 498) AS source_pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 498) AS facts, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 498) AS notes, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page = 498) AS mcqs, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id = o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page = 498) AS mcq_options, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0494-0498:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type = 'fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id = d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 497)) OR (d.entity_type = 'note' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id = d.entity_id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 497)) OR (d.entity_type = 'mcq' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.id = d.entity_id AND m.source_page = 498))) AS search_documents, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 498) AS fact_verifications, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments WHERE source_page BETWEEN 494 AND 498) AS tag_assignments;
